I have farmed this land since I was a girl, so I trust our local maize seed that I save from each harvest—it grows well here and costs nothing. I will carry manure from our cattle and spread it on this plot before the rains come, because we cannot afford chemical fertilizer from the shop. My children and I will weed by hand twice this season, and since the plot is small, we will not pay for hired labor or expensive sprays.
